engine: Clinical Diagnostic Rule Engine (Viva Fallback / GPT-4 Pipeline)

patient.symptoms_raw: I've had a fever and cough since yesterday. I also feel tired, have a mild headache, and have a sore throat when swallowing.

triage.label: MODERATE - Routine Consultation / Monitored Self-Care
triage.urgency_rationale: Symptoms are consistent with moderate acute presentation. Monitor closely and schedule consultation if persistent.

possible_conditions.name: Tension-type headache
possible_conditions.description: Most common primary headache disorder, presenting as dull, bilateral pressure or tightness.

possible_conditions.name: Migraine without aura
possible_conditions.description: Recurrent neurovascular headache disorder often moderate-to-severe, unilateral, or throbbing.

possible_conditions.name: Cervicogenic headache
possible_conditions.description: Referred pain from cervical spine musculature and neck fatigue.

clinical_analysis.why_considered: Reported head discomfort, duration, and intensity match benign primary headache patterns, though focal neurological signs must be ruled out.
additional_information_needed: Is the pain throbbing, sharp, or a dull tight band around your head?
Do bright lights or loud sounds worsen your headache?
Have you experienced any visual changes, numbness, or tingling?
clinical_analysis.medical_attention: Seek medical evaluation if headaches increase in frequency, fail to respond to standard analgesics, or present with sudden thunderclap onset.
clinical_analysis.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This is an informational analysis and not a medical diagnosis.
